issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode change is a silent behavior break for existing users
issues.detail: Flipping the default from EXTERNAL to FIXED changes endpoint handling for every caller that took the default. The changelog mentions it under 'fixed' but this is a behavioral default change, not a fix. Existing pipelines relying on EXTERNAL behavior will silently shift. Call it out as a breaking default in the changelog or keep EXTERNAL as default and document the recommendation.

issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is used but never imported or defined in the diff
issues.detail: _enable_vad now checks EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED but the diff shows no new import or enum addition. If FIXED doesn't exist on the installed speechmatics enum, this raises AttributeError at construction time. Either the SDK 0.0.99 added it and the test/build evidence belongs in the PR, or this is broken. Show me it imports.

issues.description: Patch does at least three things — split into separate diffs
issues.detail: This is THREE-PATCHES: (1) switch UserStoppedSpeakingFrame to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, (2) add FIXED turn mode and flip default, (3) add split_sentences parameter and SpeechSegmentConfig wiring. Each is independently reviewable and revertable. Bundling them makes bisecting any future regression painful for the next maintainer.

issues.description: Cosmetic-only move of a commented-out line in _handle_start_of_turn
issues.detail: The `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` line was relocated from after to before two awaits with no functional effect. Either uncomment it and explain why, or delete the dead comment. Moving dead code around pollutes the diff and wastes review time. Drop it from this patch.

issues.description: split_sentences default coercion uses `or False` instead of explicit None handling
issues.detail: `emit_sentences=params.split_sentences or False` collapses None and False to False, which happens to be correct here but obscures intent. The field is `bool | None`. Just write `emit_sentences=bool(params.split_sentences)` or check `is True`. Small, but it's the kind of thing the maintainer-six-years-from-now squints at.

issues.description: Docstring for turn_detection_mode still says EXTERNAL is for Pipecat's built-in endpointing
issues.detail: The class-level docstring was updated to say FIXED is default, but the surrounding sentence 'If using Pipecat's built-in endpointing, then use TurnDetectionMode.FIXED' contradicts the prior framing where EXTERNAL meant Pipecat-controlled. Clarify what FIXED versus EXTERNAL actually mean now — they cannot both be 'Pipecat-controlled' without confusion.

review.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The patch bundles three logically independent changes — a frame-type switch, a default mode flip with a new enum value, and a new split_sentences feature — which should land as three diffs for bisectability. The silent default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a behavior break that the changelog files as a 'fix'; that's mislabeling. EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is referenced but not visibly imported in the diff — either the SDK upgrade added it (show the evidence) or this breaks at import time. Cosmetic comment-move and `or False` coercion are nits, but the structural problem is scope and the default change.
